headlines.title: Inflation Sped Up Again in May, Dashing Hopes for Relief
headlines.abstract: The Consumer Price Index picked up by 8.6 percent, as price increases climbed at the fastest pace in more than 40 years.

headlines.title: Federal Reserve announces biggest interest rate hike since 1994
‘Slamming on the brakes’: economists react to the Federal Reserve’s rate hike
Federal Reserve Takes Swing at Inflation With Largest Rate Increase Since 1994
headlines.abstract: Central bankers raised interest rates by three-quarters of a percentage point, and signaled that they expect rates to be sharply higher by the end of the year.

headlines.title: Tough action on interest rates in the US. But how rattled is the US Federal Reserve?
